implies.if:
the asam-mcd2 (asap2) specication [25] defines standard limits and extended limits.  extended limits exist, the standard limits may be violated upon user confirmation. note that in consequence, of this definition, the following approach applies for a2l generation:
•  only one dataconstrrule with constrlevel set to 0 is specied, it represents the standard limits in a2l. no extended limits are generated.
•  two dataconstrrule exist,
implies.then:
:
  - the one with constrlevel set to 0 represents to the extended limits
  - the one with constrlevel set to 1 represents to the standard limits
note that even if this is somehow counterintuitive (since the one with constrlevel set to 0 changes its role), it matches the best to the definitions in asam-mcd2.

implies.if: the number of rulearguments.arguments exceeds the number of elements of an array that it is applied to
implies.then: the rulearguments.arguments that go beyond the last element of the array shall be ignored.

implies.if: the following rule applies to rulebasedvaluespecications of rule fill_until_end:  the number of rulearguments.arguments is smaller than the number of elements of the array it is applied to
implies.then: the value of the last rulearguments.argument shall be applied to any following element of the array until the last element of the array.

implies.if: the following rule applies to rulebasedvaluespecications of rule fill_until_max_size:  the number of rulearguments.arguments is smaller than the number of elements of the array it is applied to and smaller than maxsizetofill,
implies.then: the value of the last rulearguments.argument shall be applied to so many of the following elements that the first maxsizetofill elements of the array are filled.

implies.then:
the com layer notifies the rte of a signal outdated error.

• the rte receives a signal invalid notification from the com layer when the com layer detects that an incoming signal has the predefined “invalid” value.
